answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization is the process of outputting the most salient parts of an input in a concise and readable form... We propose ConvoSumm, a benchmark of four new, crowdsourced conversation datasets and state-of-the-art baselines on widely-used datasets that promote more unified progress in summarization beyond the news domain.
datasets: ConvoSumm (NYT comments, Reddit discussion forums, StackExchange QA, W3C email)

answer_2.quote: Table 5: ROUGE-1/2/L results for vanilla BART as well as one trained on argument-mining input... We report ROUGE-1/2/L scores to evaluate model performance.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgment annotations for two of the four quality dimensions... The annotator sees the source article and randomly-ordered output from the model and then rates the summaries for relevance and consistency on a Likert from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each summary on relevance and consistency using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
